ruleDefinitions.name: Automox Uninstall Attempt
ruleDefinitions.description: Company policy clearly states that security applications must not be disabled, altered, bypassed, or removed. These tools are not optional, and they’re not there by accident — they exist to protect our environment from threats that can impact all of us.

sequences.name: Automox Uninstall Attempt
sequences.query: (event_code: "ProcessRollup2" AND platform:"windows" AND process_command_line: RGXi("Automox_Installer") AND process_command_line: RGXi("\.(msi|exe)") AND process_command_line: RGXi(" /x") ) OR process_command_line: RGXi("launchctl bootout system/com\.automox\.agent|amagent --deregister|rm -f /usr/local/bin/amagent\*|rm -rf \"/Library/Application Support/Automox/\"|rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/com\.automox\.agent") OR (activity_type: "file-delete" AND file_name: RGXi("automox\.agent|amagent\.exe"))
